title: payment.completed
description: What stapel-orders reads from payment.completed, a fact owned and emitted by the payment module (stapel-billing; the reference fields are billing ask B1). Documentation only: never registered with on_action, because the owner's emits schema is the contract. stapel-orders acts only on reference_type == 'order', reference_key = order id, and ignores any other payload. amount is a decimal string; an amount or currency that differs from the order's total sends the order to needs_review. orders' own providers emit orders.payment.completed instead.
